surface_changes.source_support: 2023 overhead imagery depicts the red-tile roofs, gray membrane sections, court, and rooftop equipment at the location of Purdue GIS FID857.
surface_changes.dimensions_status: Texture provides observed overhead appearance only. It does not establish slopes, structural roof elevations, parapets, wall heights, or exact wing datums.

remaining_uncertainty: FID857 wing-specific structural heights and roof slopes remain unverified; the 2018 DSM includes equipment, trees, and other elevated returns.
Facade photographs are not registered to a GIS edge, so exact opening counts/positions and entrance along-wall position remain unverified.
The 2025 egress diagrams and 2022 planned floor layouts cannot be safely transformed into measured interior coordinates with the available registration evidence.
Orthophoto registration inherits the project's approximate campus tangent-plane conversion and should not be treated as survey control.
